pages.home.hero.lede: Beverage regulation is a lot to keep up with. Bring your products, markets, and source reviews into one clear workspace.
pages.home.how.intro: A useful regulatory workflow starts with your business. Set the context once, then keep the review organized.
pages.home.how.step-1-body: Add your beverage categories, ingredients, and products so your portfolio has a place in the conversation.
pages.home.how.step-2-body: Build a watchlist around your markets and the official sources you want your team to review.
pages.home.how.step-3-body: Work through the queue, save relevant updates, and export a briefing to share with a qualified reviewer.

pages.pricing.faq.1-answer: You can set up a portfolio, choose markets and sources, explore synthetic regulatory updates, save review decisions, and export a sample briefing. Your workspace stays in this browser.
pages.pricing.faq.2-answer: No. The public website demonstrates the review workflow with clearly labeled sample updates. The Regwatch engine supports source checking locally. Hosted monitoring needs a production backend before launch.
pages.pricing.faq.2-question: Does this preview monitor official sources?
pages.pricing.faq.3-answer: No. The preview has no payment collection, recurring billing, or paid entitlements. Future subscriptions will require an explicit checkout.
pages.pricing.faq.4-answer: No. Regulatory information and potential impacts require verification against primary sources and review by a qualified person.

pages.privacy.content.1-body: The public preview stores your company name, product descriptions, selected markets and sources, and review preferences in your browser’s local storage. This is a browser-local workspace, not an account. Avoid entering confidential business information in the preview.
pages.privacy.content.2-body: Export a copy in Workspace settings. Use “Clear this browser workspace” in the same screen to remove the saved workspace, or clear this site’s browser storage. Other browsers and devices do not share this workspace.
pages.privacy.content.3-body: The hosting provider may process standard request information, such as IP addresses and browser details, to serve the website. Following an official source link opens a separate website with its own privacy practices.
pages.privacy.content.4-body: The preview collects no payment details or email addresses, sends no email briefings, and creates no recurring subscription. A production account service and its privacy terms must be introduced before those features launch.
pages.privacy.content.title: Your Preview Workspace.
